# Report Generation

## Report types
- **HTML** — inline page rendering via DiSyL
- **PDF** — A4 downloadable with headers/pagination
- **Excel** — Structured columns with filters and formatting

## PDF requirements
All PDF exports must include:
- Company name (from settings)
- Report title
- Date range filter
- Generated date/time
- Generated by user
- Page numbers
- Applied filters summary
- Totals section
- Signature/approval area where appropriate

## Excel requirements
- Proper data types (numbers as numbers, dates as dates)
- Currency formatting on money columns
- Date formatting on date columns
- Filterable header row
- Totals row
- Separate sheets for multi-section reports

## Report service pattern
```php
class ReportingService
{
    public function generateProjectCostReport(array $filters, string $userId, string $format = 'pdf'): ServiceResult
    {
        // 1. Validate permissions
        // 2. Build query with filters
        // 3. Fetch data
        // 4. Generate in requested format
        // 5. Audit the export
        // 6. Return file path or stream
    }
}
```

## Report filters
Always support:
- Date range (start/end)
- Project (single or all)
- Status
- Category/type
- User (who created/approved)

## File naming
```
{report-type}_{project-id}_{date-range}_{generated-date}.{ext}
```
Example: `project-cost_PAL-001_2026-01-01_2026-06-30_2026-06-22.pdf`

## Libraries
- PDF: `nikic/PHP-Parser` or kernel's PDF abstraction
- Excel: `PhpSpreadsheet` (`phpoffice/phpspreadsheet`)

## Streaming for large exports
```php
if ($rowCount > 5000) {
    // Queue job instead of inline generation
    $this->queueReport($reportType, $filters, $userId);
    return ServiceResult::queued('Report queued. You will be notified when ready.');
}
```

## Audit
Every report export must be logged:
```sql
INSERT INTO pal_report_exports (tenant_id, report_type, filters, format, generated_by, generated_at, file_size, status) VALUES (...)
```
